headline: A 1996 executive order on placing federal offices and facilities in historic buildings in America's central cities.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order deals with how the federal government chooses locations for its offices and other facilities. It focuses on using historic properties in the central parts of cities. No summary was provided, so the specific rules and requirements are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: The order appears to guide how agencies choose sites for their facilities, with attention to historic properties in central cities.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed May 21, 1996; the material provided does not state a separate effective date.
